title: US military told to prepare for resumption of large-scale operations against Iran – Axios
description: The Pentagon has instructed the US military’s Central Command to prepare for a potential resumption of large-scale combat operations against Iran, though no specific launch date has been set. President Trump has not finalized the decision, but discussions suggest that extensive operations, potentially including bombings of key Iranian infrastructure, could occur before the upcoming US and Israeli elections.

description: Lithuania is ready to pay the cost to set up a permanent U.S. military base if Washington should agree to establish one there, the prime minister said.

title: Senegal and Morocco set for AFCON title rematch – in Swiss sports court
description: Senegal and Morocco on Thursday are again set to fight for the African Cup of Nations title – this time, in the Court of Arbitration for Sport in Switzerland. The closed-door hearing comes nine months after the Confederation of African Football stripped Senegal of their trophy after the team's players walked off the pitch to protest a penalty during the chaotic final roughly nine months ago.

title: Thousands protest presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro, fearing far-right return in Brazil
description: Thousands of people joined a student march in downtown Rio de Janeiro on Wednesday to protest against presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro ahead of Brazil's October 25 presidential runoff.
